title: Tarjeta Navideña Ghibli de Spirited Away: Escena en Miniatura de Fieltro de la Casa de Baños con Tipografía 3D Escarchada
prompt: Based on the world of Studio Ghibli's Spirited Away, design a master-level 3D Christmas card poster with extreme visual impact. The main subject is an oversized vertical composition of a thick, exquisite 3D greeting card with a deep window-like recessed compartment in the center. VISUAL CORE: Classic fictional world felt miniature scene. The card interior is an extremely rich, crowded, and lively IP-themed miniature holiday scene. All materials are wool felt and chunky knit textures with realistic delicate tactile quality. SCENE RECREATION: The scene contains a group of staggered Q-version felt models of iconic locations from Spirited Away - the felt version of Yubaba's bathhouse with multiple floors and red lanterns, Zeniba's cottage, and the train station platform. These are arranged with front-to-back occlusion creating rich layering. HOLIDAY ECOLOGY: The ground is thick cream-colored knitted snow terrain. The scene features not only a main Christmas tree decorated with colorful ornaments, but also snow-covered bushes, pine cones, and plants matching the Spirited Away aesthetic including felt versions of the magical flowers from the film. CHARACTER INTERACTION: Classic Spirited Away characters in Q-version felt form are interacting in the scene - Chihiro in Christmas outfit, No-Face wearing a Santa hat, little soot sprites carrying tiny presents, Haku in dragon form with a festive scarf - adding storytelling to the scene. WEATHER DETAILS: Inside the window, floating stationary white snowflake particles like powdered sugar suspended in air, adding atmospheric depth. TITLE DESIGN: Tilted 3D fluid frosted art typography. Floating above the card is the main title 'Merry Christmas' and subtitle '聖なるクリスマス' in 3D fluid art font. Material is translucent frosted glass presenting a deep red to light red gradient color, with soft curved matte surface texture. Light penetrates the letters casting dreamy colorful caustics, creating material contrast with the warm felt below. EXTERNAL DECORATION: Rich dynamic embellishments. Surrounding the card are abundant Christmas elements creating an explosive festive atmosphere. Red velvet ribbons and fluid gold wire spiraling and dancing in the air, interspersed with frosted pine needle branches, plump red holly berries, crystalline geometric snowflakes, and glowing golden bells. These elements create a full composition adding dynamic beauty. ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND: Eastern ink wash flowing light void. Background is a void environment with faint ink wash gradients and flowing light mist. Color tone is elegant pale champagne gold with strong breathing sense and depth. The card appears suspended in clouds with soft shadows below, using contrast between solid and void to perfectly highlight the precious and exquisite central model. BOTTOM TYPOGRAPHY: Handwritten classic quote. At the bottom shadow area, instead of rigid data, display a prominent emotional text: A famous quote related to Christmas or love from Studio Ghibli films. Style: Large elegant flowing Western handwritten serif font in rich ink. Attribution: Below the quote in small font, note the source film. RENDERING PARAMETERS: C4D, Octane render, 8K resolution, macro photography perspective, shallow depth of field (background blur), blind box toy texture mixed with frosted glass art, soft even lighting, vibrant yet sophisticated colors, masterpiece quality. Include felt versions of the iconic spirit world elements - the red bridge, paper birds, magical steam, creating a whimsical Ghibli Christmas wonderland.
